detail: Suspension of Trading - Members of the Exchange are hereby informed that the trading in equity shares of JB Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Limited shall be suspended w.e.f. July 17, 2026 (i.e., closing hours of trading on July 16, 2026) on account of the Scheme of Amalgamation.
